title: MUMINS: Metadata-conditioned Uncertainty-aware Medical Image Next-state Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.17169v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Forecasting anatomical changes such as tumor growth and neurodegeneration is a challenging generative vision task. Morphological evolution is subtle relative to static anatomy, highly patient-specific, and inherently stochastic. Existing methods struggle with several issues: deterministic networks ignore biological stochasticity, while standard diffusion models require computationally prohibitive multi-pass sampling to quantify uncertainty. We propose MUMINS (Metadata-conditioned Uncertainty-aware Medical Image Next-state Synthesis), an efficient diffusion framework that jointly diffuses a baseline scan and its follow-up residual, summed to synthesize the follow-up scan, while concurrently predicting a spatial uncertainty map, in a single reverse diffusion process. Conditioned on the time interval and relevant metadata, it preserves fine-grained anatomy by dynamically re-injecting the baseline as a soft anchor at every denoising step,

translated_title: MUMINS：元数据条件化的不确定性感知医学图像下一状态合成
translated_abstract: 预测诸如肿瘤生长和神经退行性变等解剖学变化是一项具有挑战性的生成式视觉任务。形态学演变相对于静态解剖结构而言非常细微、高度患者特异，且本质上是随机的。现有方法存在若干问题：确定性网络忽略了生物学随机性，而标准扩散模型需要计算上极其昂贵（令人望而却步）的多轮采样来量化不确定性。我们提出了MUMINS（元数据条件化的不确定性感知医学图像下一状态合成），这是一个高效的扩散框架，它在单个反向扩散过程中联合扩散基线扫描及其随访残差（两者相加以合成随访扫描），同时预测空间不确定性图。该模型以时间间隔和相关元数据为条件，通过在每个去噪步骤中将基线动态重新注入作为软锚点，来保留细粒度的解剖结构。
tldr: MUMINS是一个高效的扩散框架，在单次反向扩散过程中联合扩散基线扫描与随访残差以合成随访医学图像，并同时生成空间不确定性图，通过元数据条件化和在每个去噪步骤动态重注入基线作为软锚点来保留细粒度解剖结构。
en_tdlr: MUMINS is an efficient diffusion framework that jointly diffuses a baseline scan and its follow-up residual to synthesize follow-up scans while concurrently predicting a spatial uncertainty map in a single reverse diffusion process, preserving fine-grained anatomy via metadata conditioning and dynamic baseline re-injection as a soft anchor at every denoising step.
